name: The Moon
description: Trace the horizon walked by Apollo crews and prepare to explore a world shaped by ancient impacts.
facts: About 384,400 km from Earth on average
Surface gravity is about one-sixth of Earth's
Its permanently shadowed polar regions hold water ice
imageAlt: Apollo 11 astronaut beside the Lunar Module on the Moon

name: Mars
description: Follow robotic explorers across a cold desert world in search of clues to its watery past and habitability.
facts: Its atmosphere is mostly carbon dioxide and very thin
Olympus Mons is the largest volcano in the Solar System

name: Deep Space
description: Look into stellar nurseries and distant galaxies, where observatories turn faint light into cosmic history.
facts: The Carina Nebula is roughly 7,600 light-years away
Webb observes the universe primarily in infrared light
Light from distant objects takes time to reach us
imageAlt: The spiral galaxy Messier 94, seen in a wide-field image of deep space
